title: rafnia capensis
intro: Rafnia capensis, commonly known as Rafnia, is a type of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been traditionally used in South African folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rafnia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, that help to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Rafnia capensis on human health.
